name: OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List — machine-readable
description: The U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN list parsed into JSON and CSV: 19181 designated entries and 20169 alternate identities (39350 names total), each with its OFAC uid, entity type and sanctions programs. Published 2026-07-29 by OFAC.
source: U.S. Treasury OFAC — Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN)
scope: OFAC SDN list primary names and alternate identities only. Does NOT include the OFAC Consolidated (non-SDN) lists, the Sectoral Sanctions Identifications (SSI) list, EU/UK/UN or any other jurisdiction's list, and does NOT perform 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis.
disclaimer: Unofficial machine-readable mirror, provided for engineering use. OFAC's own SDN search at https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/ is the authoritative source and should be used for any compliance decision. Nothing here is legal or compliance advice.
license: CC0-1.0 (packaging). The underlying list is a U.S. Government work in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).

fields.name: uid
fields.description: OFAC's own entity number (ent_num) for the designated party.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Primary designated name, verbatim from OFAC's SDN.CSV.

fields.name: programs
fields.description: OFAC sanctions program codes, e.g. RUSSIA-EO14024, SDGT.

fields.name: alternateNames
fields.description: AKAs joined from OFAC's ALT.CSV on the same uid.
